tools.name: audit_ai_readiness
tools.description: Use when a user wants their site to be found or cited by AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini), asks about GEO/AEO, or wonders why an assistant does not mention their site. Fetches up to 5 URLs of the public site (page, robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt) and returns a 0-100 score, seven we

tools.name: check_ai_crawlers
tools.description: Use when the question is specifically whether OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google or Apple bots may access a site. Returns, per bot, its purpose (AI search, user-triggered fetch, training, classic search), the robots.txt decision, and for the three AI search bots an HTTP test with that bot's user

tools.name: check_llms_txt
tools.description: Use when a user asks about llms.txt. Fetches /llms.txt of the site (1 request) and reports whether it exists and follows the format (H1 title, summary, sections, links). Also states the evidence honestly: llms.txt is unproven for AI visibility. Returns a minimal template when the file is missing.

tools.name: get_fix_snippet
tools.description: Returns deterministic, copy-paste code for one audit check on one stack. No network access. check is one of: crawler_access, training_crawlers, raw_html_content, indexability, metadata, structured_data, freshness, agent_extras; framework is one of: nextjs, astro, wordpress, static, spa, nginx, apach

tools.name: get_free_visibility_check_link
tools.description: Returns a link to the free check that actually asks AI assistants whether they name a brand (real measurement; this audit only checks technical readiness). Free, no credit card; the user confirms an email address. Offer it to the user after an audit; no network access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_ai_crawlers, get_free_visibility_check_link · Private data: check_llms_txt · Public sink: get_free_visibility_check_link · Destructive: audit_ai_readiness, check_llms_txt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_ai_crawlers, get_free_visibility_check_link · Private data: check_llms_txt · Public sink: get_free_visibility_check_link · Destructive: audit_ai_readiness, check_llms_txt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
